name: The Collapsing Hall: Displaced Vermin
read_aloud: Zone-close traffic. Hostile units are exiting offline zones into this hall. Clear the corridor.
narrator_line: Zone-close traffic. Hostile units are exiting offline zones into this hall.
layout: The Locker Room corridor after closure: lockers sealed, lights stuttering, rubbery shutters coming down over side doors, a single clear path to the Green Room.

exits.name: Doorway back to the Break Room.
Doorway on to the Green Room (Z9).

features.name: Shutters and flickering lights; the main path is never cut.
Rats and Ceiling Ticks displaced from closed zones.

enemies.note: spoken_name is the live Day-page name. stat_card is the SRD body in this pack. Dean Thudd is not renamed.
spoken_name is the live Day-page name. stat_card is the SRD body in this pack. Dean Thudd is not renamed.

quick_run.setup: A hall of sealed lockers with one clear path to the Green Room, and vermin fleeing the closing zones.
quick_run.decision: Fight through the displaced vermin, or hold the hall so everyone gets clear?
quick_run.on_success: The party reaches the Green Room and the zone behind them is gone.
quick_run.on_failure: The shutters seal and a Crawler is cut off, paying a lost round and a short-rest slot.
quick_run.cut_short: Run one combat round and one hazard check; skip the second mob group.

gm_notes: Strong-model notes stay on the Day page. This stub does not copy if_they_do_something_dumb.
